name: FusionAuth
tagline: Self-hostable authentication and authorization API for users, tenants, and MFA
description: FusionAuth is a complete identity platform that provides a REST API for managing users, tenants, applications, roles, MFA, and OAuth/OpenID Connect. Available as self-hosted software or managed cloud. Developers integrate via HTTP APIs with API key authentication for admin operations and OAuth for end-user login flows.

auth.details: API key via Authorization header or X-FusionAuth-TenantId; exact format verified from official docs
